environmentVariables.name: DBGPROBE_INTERFACE

environmentVariables.description: Interface speed in kHz (default: 4000).
environmentVariables.name: DBGPROBE_SPEED_KHZ

environmentVariables.description: Plugin policy: 'all' or comma-separated plugin names. Unset = disabled.
environmentVariables.name: DBGPROBE_MCP_PLUGINS
